narrative.overview: Sakti POS is a solid, dependable money surface. Confidence comes from restraint and precision, not decoration — the cashier and owner feel in control of every rupiah on screen, and the interface recedes so the transaction is the focus. At rest the system is calm: hairline borders, a cool cream surface, deep forest-green as the dominant voice, bright cash-mint as a sparing confirmation accent. On interaction and on signature surfaces it becomes tactile and confident — buttons push back with a soft green-tinted lift, the FAB springs, the mobile nav bubble rises with a deliberate overshoot. Depth is carried by confident lift rather than flat tonal layering: elevated, active, and signature elements get real green-tinted shadows, while the resting baseline stays a single hairline border. Warmth is place-aware, not wash-based: Indonesian local-commerce warmth arrives through the terracotta accent and tight geometric display type, never through a beige background.
keyCharacteristics: Deep forest-counter (#094933) as the dominant brand voice; cash-mint (#3cd070) as a sparing confirmation accent; terracotta as a themed signal.
Plus Jakarta Sans for display headings and figures (tight -0.01 to -0.02em); Inter for all body, UI, and labels.
Hairline resting borders + green-tinted confident shadows on lift; 3px green focus glow on inputs.
Two-mode navigation: hover-expand desktop rail + FAB, and a mobile bottom magic-nav with a rising + bubble.
Sheet-over-banner dashboard composition: deep-green banner zone with a cream content sheet sliding up over it.
Full light/dark theme; dark is true neutral charcoal that keeps the green accents intact.

rules.name: The Cool-Surface Rule
rules.body: Body and card surfaces are cool near-whites. Never introduce warm beige/peach/parchment body washes; warmth is terracotta + display type only.

rules.name: The Mint-Rarity Rule
rules.body: Cash Mint (#3cd070) is a confirmation accent used on ≤10% of any screen. Its brightness is its value.

rules.name: The Orphaned-Lavender Ban
rules.body: The legacy --color-accent-4: #f6d0ff token is unused and NOT part of the active palette. Do not introduce it.

rules.name: The Tight-Display Rule
rules.body: Display and figure tracking stays at -0.01 to -0.02em; never tighter than -0.04em, never tracked out.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-Is-A-Label Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked caption is for single functional domain/status labels only, not a per-section eyebrow reflex.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Importance Rule
rules.body: Shadow depth is proportional to how far an element floats above the content plane. Resting = hairline only; never pair a 1px border with a wide decorative shadow as ornament.

dos: Do let forest-counter (#094933) carry the surface commitment; use cash-mint (#3cd070) only as a sparing confirmation accent (≤10%/screen).
Do use the CVA button matrix (look × tone × size); never hand-roll a one-off button.
Do keep resting surfaces on a hairline border and reserve green-tinted shadows for hover/active/signature elements.
Do use tabular-nums for every money figure, count, and the clock.
Do keep display tracking at -0.01 to -0.02em.
Do design for one-handed touch first: ≥44px targets, thumb-reachable primary actions, bottom-sheet actions on mobile.
Do keep body text ≥4.5:1 contrast; legibility under retail glare is a trust requirement.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: replace overshoot/spring with a crossfade or instant transition.
donts: Don't introduce warm beige/cream/peach/parchment body washes — surfaces are cool near-whites (Cool-Surface Rule).
Don't reuse the orphaned --color-accent-4: #f6d0ff lavender (Orphaned-Lavender Ban).
Don't apply a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section (Eyebrow-Is-A-Label Rule).
Don't make this look like a Square/Toast/Shopify POS reskin, cluttered legacy POS, or sterile placeless all-white app.
Don't pair a 1px border with a wide (≥16px blur) decorative shadow on one element as ornament (Lift-On-Importance).
Don't convey status by color alone — money in/out and success/failure must read via icon + label + value.
Don't use bounce/elastic easing for ambient entrance reveals; reserve overshoot/spring for signature tactile moments only.
